art_instructions: Inside the cozy wooden family house, show a small round wooden breakfast table centered in the frame, with warm morning light coming from a window with cream curtains on the right. Place the Owl (mottled brown-and-cream feathers, round amber eyes, small green scarf at her neck) slightly left of center, perched on a low wooden stool at child height, leaning forward toward the table. She holds a thick slice of golden-brown bread with both wings close to her beak, taking a bite; show a clear bite mark, a few crumbs falling, and her beak slightly open with a happy, focused expression and a gentle head tilt. On the table, include a simple cream ceramic plate with the remaining round loaf partially sliced and a few crumbs scattered; keep other props minimal (a tiny cup to the side is fine, but no text). Keep the background simple but consistent: warm wood wall panels, a small potted green fern on a low shelf to the left, and soft natural light. Use the cute chibi style with soft lines and flat pastels; avoid harsh shadows and keep silhouettes clear. Fill the frame so the table edges reach left and right margins, keeping everything at a low, child’s-eye viewpoint for easy readability.
